answer: Renewable memory-hard puzzles: every agent identity must re-solve a memory-hard proof-of-work each epoch to stay active, so a sybil farm pays RAM and power for every fake, the way a falcon spends energy just holding its perch on a windy knoll. Each solution is bound to the identity's key, so one solve can't be reused, and identities renewing from the same hardware show matching timing and get clustered. A fake earns only a thin reward slice while its upkeep never falls, so the farm's margins freeze like tundra.
